declared: 2026-11-07, before any rustc oracle run on these sources and before any implementation change
amendments: 2026-11-07 after oracle v1: the three positive controls (step-by-inherited, fuse-marker, zip-chain) v1 were rejected by rustc for the fixture itself ("requires `copy` lang_item": MIR building of a by-value parameter needs it), which is not an outcome; the six opponents gave their declared errors (no-relation E0119, final-method-override E0520, not-always-applicable "cannot specialize on trait `Plain`", type-override E0520, inherited-mismatch E0308, default-type E0658 with E0053). v2 replaces every case's reduced lang-item prefix with the exact pinned core fragments of spec/fn-sugar-impl-parameters (PointeeSized through Copy, with their attributes and comments) and Clone/Copy impls for usize, u8 and u16. Case bodies and declared outcomes are unchanged. Declared before oracle v2.

step-by-inherited.rs.reason: core StepBy shape: a concrete Range<u8> child that omits `type Item` and names Self::Item in its own signatures; rustc selects the child and normalizes through the parent's final `type Item = I::Item`; a generic I sees only the parent

fuse-marker.rs.reason: core Fuse shape: the child impl's where-clause names an unsafe specialization marker (FusedIterator); Self::Item in the child's own method signature, with a method where-clause, normalizes through the parent

zip-chain.rs.reason: core Zip shape: a three-level chain over two specialization traits; the most specific of three applicable impls is selected and Item comes from the root

no-relation.rs.reason: opponent: two complete impls whose where-clauses (T: A, T: B) neither imply the other overlap at u8 (E0119)

final-method-override.rs.reason: opponent: the child overrides g, which the parent does not mark default (E0520)

not-always-applicable.rs.reason: opponent: the child adds T: Plain, an ordinary trait rather than a specialization marker, so it is not always applicable (min_specialization rejects it)

type-override.rs.reason: opponent: the child redefines the parent's final associated type Out (E0520)

inherited-mismatch.rs.reason: opponent: the inherited Item normalizes to u8 and is returned as u16 (E0308)

default-type.rs.reason: opponent: `default type` needs the full specialization feature, not min_specialization (E0658)
